proposals.title: Replace removed NOAA solar-wind contracts with RTSW one-minute adapters
proposals.exactChange: Sandbox NOAA SWPC rtsw_mag_1m.json and rtsw_wind_1m.json as replacements for the two approved HTTP 404 endpoints. Preserve spacecraft/source flags and all quality fields. Keep compact summary products separate.
proposals.why: The approved magnetic and plasma endpoints continue to return HTTP 404, while NOAA's official RTSW directory lists current one-minute magnetic and wind products.
proposals.expectedBenefit: Restore IMF vectors, speed, density, temperature, upstream spacecraft identity, and quality-aware near-real-time telemetry.
proposals.defaultAction: Do not enable. Continue reporting both approved contracts as failed.

proposals.title: Add NOAA compact solar-wind and F10.7 summary companions
proposals.exactChange: Sandbox solar-wind-mag-field.json, solar-wind-speed.json, and 10cm-flux.json as compact health companions. They must never silently replace full time-series feeds.
proposals.why: NOAA's official summary directory exposes small operational products that can provide freshness checks when larger feeds fail.
proposals.expectedBenefit: Fast current-state health checks and bounded degraded operation.
risks: risk of being mistaken for complete telemetry

proposals.title: Add a bounded regional GloTEC adapter
proposals.exactChange: Build a sandbox adapter for regional GloTEC sampling with bounded payload size, TECU units, observation counts, quality_flag, missingness masks, and explicit assimilated MODEL-DERIVED labelling.
proposals.why: NOAA describes GloTEC as a current global near-real-time data-assimilative TEC product and exposes JSON and NetCDF data.
proposals.expectedBenefit: Add ionospheric TEC and observation-quality context for radio propagation and cross-temporal studies.
risks: confusion between assimilated model output and direct measurement
proposals.privacyConsentImpact: Regional extraction must retain approximate-location defaults and private storage.

proposals.title: Enable exact raw-body evidence transport and SHA-256 receipts
proposals.exactChange: Run the Node 24 harvester in a workflow or local worker context that exposes exact response bytes and headers, then generate SHA-256 receipts, idempotent dated bundles, retention limits, and downloadable artifacts outside main.
proposals.why: The current retrieval layer exposed parsed representations but not original response bytes; direct raw download failed with a connector client error.
proposals.expectedBenefit: Reproducible evidence bundles, exact provenance, parser regression tests, and trustworthy nightly comparisons.
proposals.privacyConsentImpact: Exact coordinates remain prohibited without separate approval; approximate configured coordinates remain private.
proposals.defaultAction: Continue partial packets and make no checksum-completeness claim.

proposals.title: Keep NASA DSN Now in evidence-gathering status
proposals.exactChange: Continue looking for a documented machine-readable NASA or JPL interface and explicit automated-use terms. Do not scrape or enable the interactive DSN Now display.
proposals.why: NASA states DSN Now uses real-time ground-station data updated every five seconds, but no approved machine contract is present and the public display currently reports maintenance unavailability.
proposals.expectedBenefit: Could eventually add antenna, spacecraft link, radio band, direction, and data-rate telemetry.
risks: temporary spacecraft misidentification during off-nominal searches
proposals.defaultAction: Remain metadata-only; no scraping or ingestion.
